title: Macy’s Kicks Off the 100-Day Countdown to the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade®
summary: As America's most beloved holiday tradition approaches its 100th Parade, Macy's is inviting customers to join a 100-day celebration of the people, traditions, memories and moments that have made the Parade a cherished part of holidays for generations. Macy’s is kicking off a 100-day countdown to the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade ® , a once-in-a-century milestone that has inspired timeless traditions, sparked imaginations and created unforgettable memories for decades. As the creator of this beloved holiday spectacle, and as part of the brand’s Celebrations Start at Macy’s platform, Macy’s is welcoming customers to this milestone journey to celebrate life’s biggest and smallest moments over the next 100 days as the kickoff to Thanksgiving begins.
